about_the_game:
You are Alex, a young security guard on his first night shift at an abandoned boarding school. What seemed like a routine job soon turns into a nightmare as you begin to discover that the shadows of the past still roam the halls of the place.

In this place dwells the skeletal figure of the former principal, a terrifying presence that crawls from the past and now wanders the corridors as an entity of pure darkness. But the true torment lies with the haunting mannequins: hollow forms that represent the souls of the children who were once victims of the boarding school. They move when you look away and freeze under the light, as if for a moment they remember who they once were. Only with glow sticks can you gain a respite from them, though never for long.

The gameplay experience is centered on survival. Puzzles reveal fragments of the history of the boarding school and those who inhabited it, while light becomes your most valuable resource for orientation, defense, and staying alive. Every chase happens in real-time, forcing you to make quick and precise decisions.
